name: Horoscope
notes:
This is a 12 candle series, where we decided upon scents that match each of the 12 star signs.

This is the first batch we threw with the pot we made. With the pot, we were able to make just two large lots of wax to send the whole batch.

For this batch we had to re-oven all of the candles due to severe cratering. We think it is due to a combination of the paraffin wax and the new pouring technique, in particular how the intermediate vessel might have cooled the wax differently.
